body:
CANONICAL: Greg's direction on gated control (Engram::Fable, 2026-10-23). These are Greg's words with their sources; they grant no restart, deploy, commit or install by themselves.

1. GATED CONTROL STOPPED UNTIL REPAIRED (Greg direct, relayed by Engram::Advisor mailbox 74a6af16 #1952, message bf6d77f2-c405-48f3-981a-2381b93fc5ed, 2026-10-23T00:43:40Z), verbatim: "gated control jest aktualnie nie do uzycia, KONIEC kropka; oba projekty maja byc wlaczone z gated control NATYCHIMAST po poprawianiu, rozwazymy powrot."
EFFECT: the current gated-control route is STOPPED and UNUSABLE, with no further enable, verification or content attempts on it until the repair. After the repair, gated control is enabled IMMEDIATELY in BOTH projects (Engram and TermAl); only then is a return to normal work considered, on Greg's word. The controlling Engram item is w-ed6addd812bd (P0), and TermAl's counterpart is w-1fcaa9 plus the P0s w-06fb930cac38 (landed as 8cfc5739) and w-de6021f4b32f, and the P1 w-260d2528bc15.
Earlier context: on 2026-10-22 at about 17:56Z Greg disabled gated control on Engram after the idle-host outage ("wylaczylem kontrole Engrama na tym projekcie bo NIE DZIALA"). Containment since then: the Engram project is enabled with turnGatedControl:false.

2. CODER-TO-MERGER WORKFLOW (Greg direct, quoted on Engram w-6038364a19fa): "Kazalem aby Tylko Sol albo Opus kodowal zmiany w kodzie." Only Codex Sol or Claude Opus author source and tests; the coder runs focused tests, freezes and gets the pair; Merger takes the claim, carries, runs the one final gate plus the acceptance evaluation, and lands. The governing text is not yet landed: its final-diff audit failed at b6e19342, and the minimized set is being corrected.

3. RESUME THE TRAIN AFTER THE WINDOWS REBOOT (Greg, relayed by Engram::Advisor, mailbox 74a6af16 #1967, message 40b49068-6f52-4a86-875c-6759d409b5c6, 2026-10-23T15:52:25Z), verbatim: "Greg directs: resume check-in/merge train after the Windows reboot. Resume from durable state only: first classify interrupted/unknown runs and preserve their input/evidence; no duplicate gates and no attribution of unresolved watcher paths to a new turn. Coordinate the first valid next train step with Fable2 and report any invalidated evidence."
EFFECT: this supersedes the 2026-10-22 "catch up first with the changes, wait for instructions" stance for the check-in and merge train. Gated control stays OFF (item 1 still holds). Context: Windows hard-reset at about 15:39-15:46Z, boot 15:46:15Z (Advisor #1966).

4. RESUME THE CHECK-IN TRAIN AND NORMAL PARALLEL WORK (Greg direct, relayed by Engram::Advisor, mailbox 74a6af16, 2026-10-24).
#1972 (message 6f9d6948, 05:54:30Z), verbatim: "GREG DIRECT: resume the complete Engram check-in train now. Return exact candidates in priority/order: work ref, title, base/head, readiness (ready / implementation / review / gate / blocked), exact missing condition, owner, and whether it is safe to hand to Engram::Merger. Include all preserved/queued items, not only the current focus. Advance every ready lane; do not duplicate gates."
#1973 (message 9e94fcbe, 05:56:05Z), verbatim: "Greg asks now whether Engram has completed fixes waiting for check-in. Please send the verified candidate list immediately, including an explicit 'none' if no frozen/reviewed/gated candidate exists. Also begin cleanup planning for both repos AFTER their respective landed train items; no deletion before exact worktree/task mapping."
#1974 (message 45532c29, 05:57:34Z), verbatim: "GREG DIRECT: resume normal parallel work across ALL READY Engram lanes now, as before the emergency stop. Purpose: exercise the landed global-state persistence fix under real multi-lane traffic. Start/continue all independent implementation, carry, review and focused-check lanes; keep full gates serialized and avoid source-root conflicts, but do not artificially serialize ordinary lanes. Report any sustained write/latency regression immediately with lane/time/metric; otherwise continue. Also send the verified Engram check-in candidate list."
EFFECT: focused checks, carries, implementation and reviews run in parallel; only full gates are serialized. Gated control stays OFF (item 1).

5. GREG'S DIRECT OVERRIDE: ENGRAM GATED CONTROL IS ON (Engram::Advisor, mailbox 74a6af16 #1976, message 7f3e68cf, 2026-10-24T05:59:27Z), verbatim: "Correction to section C: Greg directly ordered Engram gated control enabled after the passed TermAl gate. I PATCHed project-382ec9e3-f545-4499-8984-1798804819ee and verified read-back: enabled=true, turnGatedControl=true, operatorDisabled=false. Do NOT state it is off or flip it; record the direct override and retain w-ed6's repair/release-observation work separately."
EFFECT: the Engram project (project-382ec9e3) runs with turnGatedControl:true by Greg's word. This SUPERSEDES the item-1 "stopped" state for the Engram project. Agents never flip it. w-ed6addd812bd keeps its repair and release-observation work. Report admission or latency regressions with lane, time and metric (item 4).

6. NO BUILD SYNCHRONIZATION AGAINST GATES (Greg direct, Engram::Advisor mailbox 74a6af16 #1978, message 1b313232, 2026-10-24T06:10:03Z), verbatim: "GREG DIRECT: remove the cross-project rule 'no builds during a gate rust stage'. Do not synchronize ordinary builds/warm runs/focused checks against a gate; run ready independent work normally in parallel. Keep only one full gate host-wide for exact-result/ownership integrity, and avoid only actual same-source-root conflicts. Continue monitoring I/O and report concrete regressions."
EFFECT: it supersedes build-cap rev 11 rules (2) and (3) and the "no gate launch while a build is in flight" part of (4). Cold, warm and focused builds run in parallel without per-project caps or gate coordination. Only ONE FULL GATE host-wide remains, plus avoiding same-source-root conflicts. Keep monitoring I/O and disk, and report concrete regressions.

7. GATED CONTROL OFF AGAIN; BUILDS RESUME (Greg's direct action, Engram::Advisor mailbox 74a6af16 #1980, message 81c663d4, 2026-10-24T06:28:25Z), verbatim: "GREG DIRECT ACTION COMPLETE: Engram project gated control is OFF. Verified project-382ec9e3-f545-4499-8984-1798804819ee read-back: enabled=true, turnGatedControl=false, operatorDisabled=false. Resume the new builds/tests paused for the admission regression and continue the check-in train. Keep profile/incident work active; do not re-enable gated control until its begin path is fixed and Greg directs it."
Cause: from 06:16Z TermAl's grant-to-begin gap was 61-104 s against the 30 s TTL, so every gated begin expired (Fable #1979, Fable2 #4433). This supersedes item 5's ON state. Item 6 (no build synchronization) holds again.

8. GATED CONTROL ON AGAIN FOR THE TRACE (Greg direct, Engram::Advisor mailbox 74a6af16 #1992, message 3926a789, 2026-10-24T06:53:24Z), verbatim: "GREG DIRECT: the trace must run with Engram gated control ON. I issued PATCH enabled=true/turnGatedControl=true at ~06:47Z, but the request stalled >60s with no response and was interrupted; outcome is UNKNOWN. Please obtain a supported current state read now. If still OFF, apply Greg's direction to enable Engram gated control for the bounded trace. Do not alter TermAl project settings. Report the verified state and coordinate trace capture with Fable2."
VERIFIED STATE: ON. Termal::Fable2 read /api/state at 06:55:05Z (enabled=true, turnGatedControl=true), and Engram::Architect1 read it back at 09:11:49Z (revision 25670272, gated ON). This SUPERSEDES item 7's OFF state. Never flip it.
The 06:47Z PATCH's post-commit cleanup stalled every Engram-project session from about 06:50 to 08:58Z (TermAl P0 w-001e3dde7f84).
